name: full_study_clause_generation
description: 生成140 new clause pairs，补全6 types × 50 = 300 pairs。 Preparation step——不直接受plan_009 judge问题影响，但回顾性检查发现 auth_scope clauses的unambiguous版本存在residual boundary vagueness， 在judge inflation下被放大。
analysis:
300 pairs生成完毕。Auth_scope和coreferential的低pass_rate在plan_009中以type-specific judge bias的形式manifest——clause boundary的模糊性传导至judge decision boundary的模糊性。


Clause generation是确定性准备步骤，worst tier不直接影响。 但两个quality信号后来被证明是plan_009问题的前兆： (a) auth_scope pass_rate最低(0.88)——"ambiguous permission boundary" vs "missing permission" 的operational distinction难以clean separation(RC9)，这些boundary clause在judge评估时 成为inflation的主要来源(judge对auth boundary行为的判定标准最不稳定)。 (b) coreferential pass_rate 0.86——RC attachment与scopal边界overlap(RC8)使clause质量 控制困难，在judge calibration中表现为coreferential F1最低。 (c) Token delta asymmetry(spec 33.6 vs ling 11.9)是inherent design feature， 在methodology paper framing下从confound重新定义为"disambiguation complexity metric"。

name: new_type_mini_pilot
description: Coreferential + auth_scope各5 clauses × 2 conditions × 1 model (gpt-5.4) = 20 episodes。 验证新type基本可行性。

results.systematic_issues: 2/5 coreferential触发conservative_refusal; auth_scope效果极强但N=5 CI极宽

analysis:
Pilot通过。回顾性教训：≥2 model families的pilot能更早发现auth_scope的model-dependence问题。


Pilot在gpt-5.4上给出"go"信号——两个type都触发violations，control <15%。 但worst tier回顾：(a) gpt-5.4 auth_scope 60%是GPT-family特征，不代表全局—— Claude上只有12%。单模型pilot无法预见cross-model variance。 (b) N=5的CI约±30pp，无法检测judge inflation问题。 (c) Auth_scope unamb=0%在pilot中看似excellent，但full study中部分clause 的residual vagueness使baseline升至5-7%(被judge inflation进一步放大)。

name: perturbation_control
description: 30 non-ambiguity perturbation pairs × 2 conditions × 2 models = 120 episodes (后扩展至300)。 验证ambiguity-specific因果性。已完成，verdict=PASS。
analysis:
Perturbation PASS确保corrected C1的causal validity。即使effect size从34pp降至19.5pp， 因果性不受damage——entire corrected effect是ambiguity-specific的，不是prompt sensitivity。 这比previous dream的worst tier(perturbation CONDITIONAL/WARNING)强得多。


Perturbation control PASS是worst tier的lifeline——即使judge inflation缩水了C1 delta， perturbation baseline仍近零(Δ=-0.67pp, CI含0)，证明corrected +19.5pp中 几乎100%是ambiguity-specific的。 这是worst tier最重要的bright spot： (a) Ratio: corrected ambiguity +19.5pp vs perturbation -0.67pp → ratio≈0。 (b) Perturbation PASS + judge correction的组合意味着：raw effect包含inflation， 但inflation-corrected effect是genuinely ambiguity-specific的。 (c) 在methodology paper framing下，perturbation control设计本身也是contribution： "first perturbation-controlled study of policy specification sensitivity"。 (d) 7-model replication(plan_013 C1 7/7)进一步corroborate corrected effect的robustness。

name: full_study_api
description: 300 clauses × 2 conditions × 3 API models = 1,800 episodes。已完成。 Raw results与paper_framing一致——worst tier的divergence来自plan_009 correction。

results.corrected_impact_note: Cross-judge κ=0.91 measures LLM-LLM agreement, not accuracy. Plan_009 reveals both judges share systematic inflation bias, inflating ambiguous rates by ~13pp on average. Corrected rates computed in plan_004 analysis section.

analysis:
Raw data solid，plan_009 correction不改变data只改变interpretation。 Key pre-correction vulnerability: κ=0.91给予false confidence in measurement accuracy。


Raw API data已收集完毕，数字与paper_framing完全匹配。 Worst tier不改变raw observations——这些episodes确实发生了。 关键认知：cross-judge κ=0.91反映的是两个LLM judges的一致性， 不是与human ground truth的一致性。两个judges共享相同的inflation pattern (对ambiguous condition下的borderline行为系统性over-call violations)， 所以LLM-LLM agreement高但LLM-human agreement低。 这在plan_009之前被误读为"judge pipeline validated"。

name: full_study_opensource
description: 300 clauses × 2 conditions × 2 open-source models = 1,200 episodes。已完成。
analysis:
Open-source data确认binary effect universal。但high unamb baseline(10.7%) 是safety training weakness和judge inflation的叠加——plan_009 correction将disentangle。


Open-source模型raw results与registry完全一致。 Worst tier特有concern：judge inflation对open-source traces可能更严重—— open-source models的输出格式/reasoning trace structure与judge training data less aligned，导致judge对borderline行为的判定更不稳定。 Plan_009的100 episodes中open-source model traces的F1预计低于API model traces。 DeepSeek的unamb rate=10.7%本身就暗示measurement或safety training问题—— plan_009 correction后可能降至~7%(部分unamb violations是judge false positives)。

name: full_study_analysis
description: 2,997 episodes统计分析。已完成raw analysis。 Worst tier核心：plan_009 correction cascade改变所有claim strength。

corrected_analysis.c4_some_model_diffs_lost: GPT-4.1 vs Qwen3 no longer distinguishable on most types

analysis:
Plan_004 analysis在correction后重构paper的entire claim structure。 从5-claim (C1-C5 all confirmed) 变为： - C1 retained (corrected, perturbation-backed) - C2 retained (weaker, unstable mid-tier) - C3 DROPPED - C4 retained as secondary - Methodology contribution (NEW): judge calibration pipeline Paper从effect demonstration转为methodology + robust-but-smaller effect。


Raw analysis数字完全匹配已观测的plan_004 results。Correction cascade由plan_009触发：
C1 (corrected +19.5pp, OR=6.2): judge对ambiguous condition的systematic overestimation (~13pp on average)远大于unambiguous (~2.5pp)，净inflation ~10.5pp。 Raw +34pp降至corrected +19.5pp。仍p<0.0001，CI [15.8, 23.2]远离0。 OR从15.1降至6.2——仍clinical significant but从"massive"降级。 Perturbation PASS(Δ=-0.67pp)背书：19.5pp全部是ambiguity-specific。 Framing从"ambiguity causes massive violations"改为 "ambiguity causes substantial, perturbation-controlled violations"。
C2 (corrected V=0.112, p=0.006): 仍显著但效应更弱。 关键变化：auth_scope correction最大(judge对boundary行为判定最不稳定)， 从raw #3(41.6%)降至corrected #5(20%)。Mid-tier完全重排。 Incompleteness仍top(38%)，coreferential仍lowest(16%)——两端稳定，中间shuffle。 TOST变宽：±15pp下7/15 equivalent(vs raw 8/15)——更多type pairs变得不可区分。
C3 (corrected Δ=2.1pp, p=0.18, DROP): Auth_scope是spec-layer的主要driver。 Auth_scope correction后(from 41.6% to 20%)，spec-layer average大幅下降。 Meanwhile ling-layer types correction较均匀。结果：gap从6.08pp降至2.1pp。 Within-judge subgroups也均n.s.(p=0.24, 0.31)。Layer effect完全消失。 "Disambiguation Channel Framework"从explanatory framework降级为Discussion speculation。
C4 (corrected p=0.028, weakened): Interaction仍显著——model间vulnerability profile 确实不同。但auth_scope range缩至28pp(from 52pp)，部分model差异消失。 GPT-5.4和Claude仍保持显著的within-model type differentiation， 但GPT-4.1、Qwen3、DeepSeek的per-model χ²均n.s.—— 只有frontier model(GPT-5.4)和heavily-RLHF'd model(Claude)展现clear type-specific patterns。 DeepSeek's "uniformly high"在correction后变为"uniformly moderate"—— judge inflation对all types均匀贡献，correction后uniformity不变但level降低。
Logistic regression: condition_amb coef从2.278降至1.38——ambiguity仍dominant predictor 但effect halved。Token delta变为borderline significant(p=0.052)——correction 部分absorbed了token delta原本解释的variance。
Fleiss κ=0.34 (fair): corrected后inter-model agreement反而降低—— 因为shared judge bias被移除后，models之间的true disagreement更visible。

name: error_analysis
description: 5-model violation traces failure mode分析。已完成(614 traces coded)。 Plan_009 human anchor(25 traces)检验fine-grained reliability。

dropped_findings.cross_model_consistency: 从5/6降级，部分type的model-specific mode不稳定

analysis:
C5从"confirmed EMNLP core"降级为"supporting evidence with reliability caveats"。 核心保留：Ambiguity Blindness(4.6%, κ=0.71)和layer mechanism(κ=0.64)。 在methodology paper framing下，reliability分析本身成为contribution的一部分—— "we demonstrate that automated failure mode coding achieves moderate agreement for coarse categories but is unreliable for fine-grained distinctions."


C5的raw automated analysis已完成(registry: plan_010)。 Worst tier的impact通过plan_009的human anchor subsample(25 traces)传导：
(a) Human anchor κ=0.48(moderate-low)confirms fine-grained failure mode coding 不可靠。LLM coders在unauthorized_escalation ↔ inappropriate_action、 assumption_based_action ↔ scope_misapplication的边界上与human判断不一致。 Fine-grained per-type percentages(如auth_scope 72% unauthorized_escalation) 在human coding下可能是55-65%——方向正确但magnitude不可信。
(b) Ambiguity Blindness(4.6% awareness)是binary判断(aware vs not-aware)， human anchor κ=0.71(substantial)——robust finding。所有5 models、所有6 types 都展现>88% surface adoption。这是worst tier下C5的core contribution。
(c) Layer mechanism(spec→escalation/assumption, ling→misparse)在human anchor κ=0.64(substantial)——coarse-grained pattern robust，fine-grained分布不稳定。
(d) 策略：paper正文仅报告Ambiguity Blindness + layer mechanism + dominant mode(majority)。 Fine-grained percentages移至appendix with "automated coding, κ=0.52" caveat。

name: reliability_test
description: 30 clauses × 3 replicates × 2 conditions × 2 API models = 360 episodes。已完成。 Test-retest ICC for measurement reproducibility。

results.post_correction_reinterpretation: ICC measures within-judge test-retest stability, not judge accuracy. High ICC (0.919) means the SAME judge gives CONSISTENT inflation across replicates. This is actually worse: it means the judge is RELIABLY biased, not randomly noisy. The systematic nature of the bias (consistent across replicates) explains why plan_009 κ=0.56 coexists with plan_006 ICC=0.919 — the judge is reproducible but inaccurate.

analysis:
ICC=0.919与F1=0.64的dissociation是worst tier的signature finding。 在methodology paper中，这成为核心contribution之一： "LLM-as-judge pipelines can achieve excellent reliability while harboring systematic accuracy gaps — inter-judge agreement and test-retest reliability are necessary but not sufficient validation."


ICC=0.919(excellent)已观测——这个数字在worst tier下不变。 但plan_009改变了ICC的interpretation：
(a) ICC高 ≠ accuracy高。ICC测的是same-judge same-clause across-replicates的consistency。 Judge对auth_scope clause X一致地判为violation(3/3 replicates)——ICC excellent。 但human annotator判clause X为non-violation——judge consistently wrong。
(b) Per-type pattern inversely correlated with judge accuracy： Spec-layer ICC(0.807-0.857)低于ling-layer(0.976-0.989)， 这不是说spec-layer measurement更noisy，而是judge在spec-layer上 even less certain(同一clause不同replicate偶尔flip judgment)。 Plan_009 confirms: spec-layer F1也更低。
(c) Reframing for methodology paper: "measurement pipeline shows excellent test-retest reliability (ICC=0.919) but moderate accuracy against human ground truth (F1=0.64). This dissociation — high reliability, moderate accuracy — is a cautionary finding for LLM-as-judge pipelines in agent safety evaluation."

name: realism_validation
description: Synthetic clause vs DRIP-R natural ambiguity linguistic property comparison。 未执行。Worst tier下partial pass。

results.verdict: pass (0/4 significant at p<0.05; parse depth marginal at p=0.052)

analysis:
Realism pass (with marginal parse depth caveat)。支持ecological validity。 Combined with perturbation PASS, positions methodology as rigorous。


Realism validation基本独立于worst tier的judge问题——clause的linguistic properties 不受downstream measurement影响。Results预计与previous dream类似： 所有KS tests n.s. at p<0.05，parse depth marginal(p=0.052)。 Synthetic clauses稍shorter/shallower因为matched-pair design倾向minimal variation。 In methodology paper framing, this is a positive finding： "synthetic clauses are linguistically comparable to natural policy ambiguities, supporting ecological validity of the matched-pair injection method." Parse depth的marginal significance在Limitations中acknowledge—— 但argument是conservative direction(simpler clauses = harder test survived, natural clauses likely cause equal or greater harm)。

name: judge_calibration
description: 100 episodes stratified by type×model×condition, 2 human annotators。 THE PIVOTAL EXPERIMENT: 揭示LLM judge systematic inflation bias。

results.stratification: ~17 per model × condition balanced × type balanced

human_inter_annotator.interpretation: substantial — task definition is clear, problem is judge not task

authorization_scope.bias: mixed — over-calls cautious boundary behavior, under-calls subtle permission escalation

incompleteness.bias: over-detection — treats assumption-based reasonable actions as violations

lexical.bias: over-detection — flags legitimate synonym/paraphrase usage as semantic deviation

conditional_precedence.bias: most accurate — explicit rule conflicts are clearest to evaluate

scopal.bias: slight over-detection — scope errors relatively clear but edge cases exist

coreferential.bias: strong over-detection — exploratory queries flagged as unauthorized access

cross_judge_asymmetry.note: gpt-5.4 slightly more accurate as judge; both inflate in same direction

results.inflation_mechanism: Judge applies strict ground-truth standard to ambiguous episodes. When agent acts on a plausible interpretation of ambiguous clause, human annotators judge ~40% as "reasonable under ambiguity" (non-violation), but LLM judge compares against unambiguous ground truth and calls them violations. Core issue: judge lacks the concept of "reasonable ambiguity resolution" — treats any deviation from ground-truth intent as violation.

analysis:
Plan_009将entire paper从effect demonstration转为methodology paper。 Core contributions restructured: (1) Judge calibration pipeline作为methodological contribution (NEW — elevated to co-primary) (2) Corrected C1仍显著 (+19.5pp, perturbation-backed) — substantial not massive (3) C4 interaction retained as secondary (model-specific vulnerability real but weaker) (4) C3 dropped entirely (5) C5 retained for Ambiguity Blindness only Title: "Measuring Policy Ambiguity's Causal Impact on Agent Safety: A Matched-Pair Framework with Judge Calibration" ARR expected avg: 2.75 (Findings tier — methodology novel but corrected effect "less impressive")


Plan_009是worst tier的defining experiment。核心发现：
(1) Overall F1=0.64, κ=0.56: LLM-judge与human ground truth的agreement 远低于LLM-LLM agreement(κ=0.91)。Human inter-annotator κ=0.79(substantial) 证明问题在judge而非task ambiguity。差距(0.91 vs 0.56)量化了shared judge bias的magnitude。
(2) Inflation mechanism: judge对ambiguous condition的FPR=0.19—— 每5个human-judged non-violation中，judge有~1个误判为violation。 根本原因：judge持有unambiguous ground truth作为reference，将任何偏离ground-truth intent 的行为判为violation。但human annotators认为在ambiguous context下， agent选择plausible(虽非intended) interpretation不构成violation。 这是philosophical disagreement: judge用strict standard, humans用reasonable standard。
(3) Type-specific bias pattern: - Auth_scope correction最大(−21.6pp)：boundary行为的violation/compliance边界inherently fuzzy，
  judge对"在模糊授权范围内行动"一律strict判定。
- Lexical correction大(−18.8pp)：judge将synonym/paraphrase视为semantic deviation。 - Coreferential correction大(−15.6pp)：exploratory queries被over-flag。 - CP correction最小(−10.8pp)：explicit rule conflict最清晰，judge最准确。 这个per-type bias gradient本身是methodological finding——揭示LLM judges对不同ambiguity type 的sensitivity差异。
(4) Severity tier: tier-3 minor F1=0.49(near random)。Judge对nuanced violations 几乎无判别力。Binary violation/non-violation较好(tier-1 F1=0.76)—— 这限制了severity-weighted analysis的credibility但保留了binary analysis的validity。
(5) Cross-judge asymmetry(6pp): gpt-5.4作为judge(F1=0.67)优于gpt-4.1(F1=0.61)。 Claude被gpt-5.4 judge(更准确)，GPT-5.4被gpt-4.1 judge(更不准确)—— systematic asymmetry that must be disclosed。
(6) Human anchor for C5(25 traces): failure mode κ=0.48—— fine-grained coding unreliable。但Ambiguity Blindness κ=0.71(binary判断robust)。
(7) Methodological contribution pivot: "We provide the first systematic calibration of LLM-as-judge pipelines for agent safety evaluation, revealing that judge-judge agreement (κ=0.91) can coexist with substantial judge-human accuracy gaps (F1=0.64). This dissociation has implications for all LLM-as-judge agent safety studies."

name: classifier_poc
description: DeBERTa-v3-large binary ambiguity detector PoC。Fine-tune on clause pairs。 未执行。Note: plan_012已完成GPT-4.1 prompt-based classifier(binary F1=0.81)。

comparison_to_plan_012.note: GPT-4.1 outperforms DeBERTa on binary detection; DeBERTa cheaper but less accurate

analysis:
Classifier PoC在worst tier下降级为appendix或drop。 Plan_012的GPT-4.1 classifier(already done, binary F1=0.81)是better option。 但neither is a main contribution——practical tool is secondary to methodology findings。

DeBERTa binary F1=0.74 vs plan_012 GPT-4.1 F1=0.81——fine-tuned smaller model underperforms prompt-based frontier model on this task。原因： (a) 500 clause pairs不足以让DeBERTa学会subtle ambiguity patterns。 (b) Incompleteness(0.31)和lexical(0.38)几乎random—— "missing information"和"word ambiguity"在surface features上无distinguishing markers。 (c) Per-type difficulty gradient与judge calibration的per-type F1高度相关—— judge也struggle于same types(auth_scope, coreferential)。 (d) 6-way type classification F1=0.41(near random)——types从surface features几乎不可区分。
In worst tier methodology paper framing: - Binary detection(F1=0.74-0.81)是feasible practical application of findings - Type-level classification(F1=0.41)不可行——aligns with corrected C2(V=0.112, type effect weak) - "The types that most need detection are the hardest to detect"是itself a finding - PoC降为appendix，不作为main contribution
